name: @equin/plugin-apps-isle-buildings
description: Isle's building contract (BuildingSpec: a declared footprint, preferred setting, sign, night lights, paint/animate on any 2D context), the watercolour-and-ink painting kit bespoke buildings reuse, and kitBuilding — a generated building per app, seeded from its id and shaped by its category. Its testing barrel measures a painter's ink without a canvas.
